title: How John Rush built 20 directories, exited one, and packaged the playbook as a $99 guide
summary: John announces his first directory exit (allGPTs.co sold to ChippAI for 5 figures) and a $99 pre-order guide on building, growing and monetizing directories. Mostly a sales pitch, but it outlines his results and the guide's scope: underserved ideas, keyword research, nocode, SEO, monetization.

principles.text: Launch many directories; a minority become winners (5 of 20 turned out great).
principles.quote: Overall, I launched 20 directories and 5 of them turned out to be great, perhaps turning into the best directories in their niche in the world

principles.text: Share what you learn publicly first; audience demand tells you when to package it into a paid product.
principles.quote: I’ve shared all I know publically on twitter, but people kept asking me to make a course or a guide, so I’m giving it a try.

principles.text: Directories can feed traffic into your other SaaS tools as a distribution channel, not just earn on their own.
principles.quote: channeled traffic to my other saas tools **worth $1m+**

principles.text: Directories monetize via affiliate links, sponsors and paid listings, and can be sold.
principles.quote: monetizing with affiliate links, sponsors, paid listings.

principles.text: Directory playbook: find underserved ideas, do keyword research, build with nocode, then market via SEO and social.
Pre-sell and let sales fund effort: put more work into the product as more people buy.
principles.quote: The more people buy it, the more effort I’ll put into making it great.
